title: The Thirsty Loop
base_prompt: Hand-drawn stick-figure storybook illustration. Warm cream parchment background with soft paper grain. Thick, rounded, slightly uneven black ink lines. Stick figures have round white heads with two dot eyes, no nose, no mouth, simple limbs and plain flat-color robes. One accent color only: warm gold (#C8963E) for light, glory and sacred things. Flat shading, generous empty space, one clear focal subject per frame, simple ancient-world settings (desert, olive trees, stone houses, tents, hills, night sky). No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no borders, no photorealism, no 3D.

characters.Hero: a bright-colored stick figure with a red shirt and blue pants, round white head, ink outline

scenes.vo: Man, I am thirsty. Let me go get something to drink.
scenes.image_prompt: The stick figure sits on a purple couch with a dry throat; a thought bubble shows a cold glass of water; he stands up and heads for the kitchen.
scenes.motion_prompt: Frame-by-frame sit-to-stand, then a walk cycle to the right.

scenes.vo: Man, I do not even have a cup. Let me go inside and get one.
scenes.image_prompt: The stick figure walks into a teal kitchen and opens an empty cupboard; a thought bubble shows a cup with a red X.
scenes.motion_prompt: Frame-by-frame walk cycle, door swings open.

scenes.vo: Man, look at that sink. I said I would do these dishes yesterday.
scenes.image_prompt: The stick figure stands at a sink with a wobbling tower of colorful dishes, hands on head; a calendar with a red X pops up in a bubble.
scenes.motion_prompt: Frame-by-frame dish tower wobble, worried face.

scenes.vo: Okay, dishes first. Wait, where is my phone?
scenes.image_prompt: The stick figure scrubs one plate, then looks around; a phone with a question mark bounces in a bubble.
scenes.motion_prompt: Frame-by-frame scrubbing, then head looking side to side.

scenes.vo: Now it is an hour later, and I still have not had a drink.
scenes.image_prompt: A dark purple background with a rainbow spiral spinning around a giant fast clock, a phone, a plate, a cup and a question mark orbiting; a small empty glass sits in the corner.
scenes.motion_prompt: Spiral and clock hands spin; icons orbit.

scenes.vo: So today I tried something small. I put on one song.
scenes.image_prompt: The stick figure with pink headphones bounces to the beat in a purple room while colorful music notes float up.

scenes.vo: One song, one cup, one dish. That is all it took to get moving.
scenes.image_prompt: The stick figure washes one plate while a cup fills with water and three green checkmarks pop in the corner.
scenes.motion_prompt: Frame-by-frame washing; water rises; checks pop.

scenes.vo: My mind was never meant to carry all of that alone.
scenes.image_prompt: The stick figure sits calm and smiling on the couch while a thought bubble holding a scribble loop shrinks and floats away; golden light grows in the window.
scenes.motion_prompt: Bubble drifts up and shrinks; glow grows.

scenes.vo: Isaiah 26:3 says, "Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace,
scenes.image_prompt: A colorful sunrise over rolling hills, sun rising with golden rays, soft clouds drifting, birds.

scenes.vo: whose mind is stayed on thee."
scenes.image_prompt: The same sunrise continuing, sun higher, sky brighter.
